# Fracture 1.0.0

Fracture 1.0.0 is the first production release of the desktop client and backend runtime. This release establishes the core Windows experience: desktop shell, embedded backend, TCP Inject and sing-box transport flows, live diagnostics, profile management, routing controls, update surfaces, and the initial CI/release pipeline.

## Highlights

### Desktop-first architecture
- Ships the Tauri desktop application with an integrated backend executable for a single-install Windows workflow.
- Improves backend lifecycle handling so the app can start, monitor, and relaunch its runtime more reliably.
- Adds app release discovery in the desktop shell so users can check for newer Fracture builds from within the product.

### Proxy and transport stack
- Introduces TCP Inject transport mode with runtime orchestration, diagnostics, timeout handling, and bridge support.
- Adds sing-box integration with routing and tunnel-aware behavior.
- Includes SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy services, system proxy integration, and network traffic metrics.
- Expands transport resilience with keepalive handling, improved reconnect behavior, and safer runtime state transitions.

### Profiles, settings, and routing
- Adds JSON profile import, drag-and-drop fixes, and sortable profile reordering.
- Introduces Cloudflare listener selection and routing-related settings for local and LAN proxy usage.
- Adds TUN mode controls and tunnel capability checks.
- Refines settings UX with grouped inputs, transport toggles, and cleaner persistence behavior.

### Observability and diagnostics
- Adds streaming logs, source-aware traces, runtime status events, and UI log visibility controls.
- Improves ping and speed test orchestration with cancellation, timeout controls, summary events, and clearer failure handling.
- Adds egress lookup handling and richer traffic visualization in the dashboard.

### Interface polish
- Delivers the first complete dashboard and settings surfaces for everyday operation.
- Refactors traffic charts to SVG-based rendering for smoother visuals and better maintainability.
- Unifies theme tokens and modernizes UI styling across the desktop shell.

### Release engineering
- Adds Windows CI validation, packaged backend builds, and Tauri integration build coverage.
- Adds the automated release workflow for tagged builds and artifact publishing.

## Included In 1.0.0

This release consolidates the work introduced across the initial project history, including:
- project scaffolding for the desktop app and backend service
- backend FastAPI runtime and route surface
- TCP Inject transport and diagnostics
- sing-box support and update handling
- system proxy, traffic accounting, ping/speed telemetry
- desktop logging, update checks, dashboard and settings refinements
- CI and release automation

## Notes

- This is the first public 1.x baseline for Fracture.
- GitHub release assets are expected to include the Windows desktop bundle together with the packaged backend executable used by the desktop runtime.
